summary: Suzano S.A. filed a Form 6-K providing notice to shareholders of a dividend declaration approved at its Annual and Extraordinary General Meeting on April 23, 2026. Additional dividends of R$5,627,858.70 (R$0.00455231 per share) were declared from FY2025 net accumulated earnings. Payment is set by December 31, 2026, based on shareholdings after B3 trading on April 29, 2026, with ex-dividend date April 30, 2026. No interest or adjustment applies. ADR holders will receive payment per depositary bank procedures. This is a routine corporate action, not a special situation; no acquisition, tender, spin-off, or restructuring elements are present.
